text:
tanya: Seeing a weird pattern: streaming clients (SSE) intermittently reconnect when proxy emits a probe that our SDK treats as terminal. Spikes started after the routing policy change to aggressive reclaim.
frank: Is probe a halfclose or a keepalive? Any sample conn ids?
tanya: Proxy logs show 'probe-frame' followed by client-side close. conn=pr-77a. Console trace: trace=0a3b.. attached.
kai: SDK currently treats unknown control frames as close. We added that to be conservative. But probe frames are meant to be non-terminal.
sre: This explains the short sessions (4-8s) and token churn. Also billing shows lots of open events.
ops-bot: ALERT: tenant=t-314 reconnect_rate=190/m at 1865440005.
frank: Short-term mitigation options: (A) proxy change: make probe a data heartbeat byte instead of control frame, (B) SDK change: tolerate probe frames and not reconnect, (C) billing debounce to avoid double-charging.
tanya: (C) seems fastest. We can debounce open-billing if previous close was probe and delta < 12s and session_id matches. Pseudoconfig: billing.open_debounce_ms=12000 require_probe_match=true
kai: I'll prepare an SDK patch to ignore probe control codes and add tests. PR link when ready.
console-bot: I can add a console tile showing probe.sent vs reconnects and a banner when the routing reclaim flag is on. That will reduce support noise.
sre: Also instrument metric probe.reinterpreted to count when we intentionally treat probe as non-terminal so we can audit behavior.
frank: For the rollout, do targeted canary on shards with highest reconnect churn. Flip billing debounce there first. Track 'billing.open_suppressed' metric.
ops-bot: FLAG_CHANGE: billing.open_debounce_ms=12000 applied to shard=eu-highchurn at 1865440048 by frank
tanya: Canary started; early signal: reconnects down ~58% for t-314, duplicate opens suppressed.
frank: Good. Next actions: kai to open SDK PR to tolerate probe, proxy team to consider using a 1-byte data heartbeat in next sprint, console-bot add panel + annotation, billing team to add a dedupe metric.
sre: Also recommend SDK default backoff jitter (base=500ms max=8s jitter=true) to avoid synchronized reconnect storms.
ops-bot: NOTE: trace sampling for /v1/stream increased for 30m.
tanya: Will monitor 30m and then ramp. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
